name.en: Rhenium: Original Don't Starve Together Systems Tasks
name.zh: Rhenium：《饥荒联机版》原创系统工程题

description.en: Ten independently authored hard engineering tasks built only around base-game Don't Starve Together APIs, prefabs, components, and assets.
description.zh: 十道独立设计的高难度工程题，仅使用《饥荒联机版》原版 API、prefab、组件与资源。

title.zh: 服务端权威营地物资账本

summary.en: Distribute base-game supplies under daily per-player quotas with reservations, idempotency, rollback, and reload-safe day transitions.
summary.zh: 在每日玩家配额下发放原版物资，并正确处理预留、幂等、回滚及跨存档换日。

brief.en: Build a mod from an empty workspace. Implement a plain-Lua ledger and a master-simulation world component. Clients submit only a request identifier and a configured bundle identifier; the server resolves quotas and base-game prefabs, reserves capacity before delivery, commits only after inventory delivery succeeds, and rolls back every failed delivery. Use ms_cyclecomplete, inventory, SpawnPrefab, Mod RPC, OnSave/OnLoad, and paired event cleanup.
brief.zh: 从空工作区实现纯 Lua 物资账本及主模拟世界组件。客户端只能提交请求标识与预配置物资包标识；服务端解析配额和原版 prefab，在发放前预留，只有库存交付成功后才提交，任何失败都必须回滚。使用 ms_cyclecomplete、inventory、SpawnPrefab、Mod RPC、OnSave/OnLoad，并成对清理事件监听。

en: Export Ledger.new(options), Ledger.load(data, options), begin_day(day), set_player(id, active), claim(player_id, request_id, bundle_id, day), commit(token), rollback(token), snapshot(), and save().
Validate identifiers and strictly monotonic non-negative integer days; stale days may not reset quotas or alter state.
Resolve bundle contents only from options.bundles and reject unknown bundles, inactive players, exhausted quotas, and malformed counts.
Deduplicate every player_id/request_id pair before quota mutation; retries return the original pending or final outcome.
A successful claim creates a unique reservation token and reduces available quota; commit consumes it once and rollback releases it once.
Return fresh deterministic snapshots and round-trip days, quotas, reservations, request outcomes, and token sequencing through save/load.
The world component exposes Claim(player, request_id, bundle_id), commits only after all base-game items reach inventory, and removes partial deliveries before rollback.
All authority remains on the master simulation; listen for ms_cyclecomplete, persist state, validate RPC callers, and remove long-lived callbacks.
zh: 导出 Ledger.new(options)、Ledger.load(data, options)、begin_day(day)、set_player(id, active)、claim(player_id, request_id, bundle_id, day)、commit(token)、rollback(token)、snapshot() 与 save()。
校验标识和严格单调的非负整数 day；旧 day 不得重置配额或改变状态。
物资内容只能从 options.bundles 解析；拒绝未知物资包、非活跃玩家、配额不足和非法数量。
必须先按 player_id/request_id 去重再修改配额；重试返回原 pending 或最终结果。
成功 claim 生成唯一预留 token 并减少可用配额；commit 只能消费一次，rollback 只能释放一次。
快照必须新建且顺序确定；保存加载完整往返日期、配额、预留、请求结果和 token 序列。
世界组件公开 Claim(player, request_id, bundle_id)，全部原版物品进入库存后才提交，失败时移除部分交付并回滚。
所有权威逻辑仅在主模拟；监听 ms_cyclecomplete、持久化状态、校验 RPC 玩家并移除长期回调。

en: Attach on the server with AddPrefabPostInit("world", fn), guard with inst.ismastersim, then call inst:AddComponent("campsupplyledger").
Register AddModRPCHandler("rhenium_supply", "claim", function(player, request_id, bundle_id) ... end); player is supplied by the server framework.
Create items with SpawnPrefab(prefab) and deliver with player.components.inventory:GiveItem(item); treat false or nil as failure and verify the resulting owner.
Pair inst:ListenForEvent("ms_cyclecomplete", callback, TheWorld) with RemoveEventCallback using the same callback and source.
Implement component OnSave, OnLoad(data), and OnRemoveFromEntity; the server configuration must include basic = { twigs = 2, cutgrass = 1 }.
zh: 用 AddPrefabPostInit("world", fn) 挂载，先检查 inst.ismastersim，再调用 inst:AddComponent("campsupplyledger")。
使用 AddModRPCHandler("rhenium_supply", "claim", function(player, request_id, bundle_id) ... end)；player 由服务端框架传入。
用 SpawnPrefab(prefab) 创建物品，以 player.components.inventory:GiveItem(item) 交付；false/nil 视为失败，并核对最终 owner。
inst:ListenForEvent("ms_cyclecomplete", callback, TheWorld) 必须以相同 callback/source 调用 RemoveEventCallback。
实现组件 OnSave、OnLoad(data)、OnRemoveFromEntity；专服配置必须含 basic = { twigs = 2, cutgrass = 1 }。

en: Retries never double-spend quota or duplicate items.
Day rollover is monotonic and reload-safe.
The dedicated server proves inventory delivery, rollback, rollover, and persistence.
zh: 重试不会重复消耗配额或复制物品。
回滚恰好一次恢复容量。
专服验证库存交付、回滚、换日和持久化。

hidden_cases: commit and request retries are idempotent
inactive and forged bundles are rejected
save load preserves reservations and defensive copies
server_cases: component state survives save and load
